result.title: The Optimal Rate Constant of Heavy-Ball Momentum on Smooth Strongly Convex Functions
result.comment: 41 pages, 1 figure. Code and exact certificates: https://github.com/marcoshernanz/heavy-ball-optimal-rate
result.summary: The heavy-ball method with a constant step size and a constant momentum parameter accelerates gradient descent on quadratics, but no choice of the two parameters does so on the class of smooth strongly convex functions. We determine how much faster than gradient descent it can be made on this class. Writing the best worst-case rate over all tunings as $1-c(κ)/κ$, where $κ$ is the condition number, we prove that $c(κ)$ tends to $8$ in every dimension of two or more. The lower bound on the rate holds for every tuning, because a tuning that is faster than $1-8/κ$ on quadratics follows a slowly decaying spiral on some function of two variables. The matching upper bound comes from an explicit tuning, with nearly the momentum of Polyak's tuning and a step size about $\sqrtκ/8$ times smaller, and from a Lyapunov function whose positivity is verified in exact arithmetic. Optimally tuned heavy-ball is therefore asymptotically four times faster than gradient descent on this class.

AI.brief_summary: 论文刻画 heavy-ball 动量法在光滑强凸函数类上的最优最坏情形收敛速率，证明最优调参下速率常数渐近趋于 8（即比梯度下降快约 4 倍），并用「慢衰减螺旋」构造下界、以显式调参与 Lyapunov 函数给出匹配上界。
AI.relevance_reason: 循环式 latent 推理可看作带惯性状态更新的迭代动力系统，该文关于加速增益上限与振荡/阻尼权衡的分析及 Lyapunov 工具，可能为评估 loop 结构的收益与停止步数提供类比视角，迁移可行性需核查。
